modules.name: BCICore
modules.role: pure-Swift models, protocols, ring buffer, intent FSM, and the dialectic engine (Sources/BCICore/Dialectic/). No third-party deps.

modules.name: BCIEEG
modules.role: EEG streams: BrainFlow facade + synthetic + playback; supervisor retry/backoff -> synthetic fallback.

modules.name: BCIClassifier
modules.role: Core ML intent classifier (ANE-preferred) + mock; CoreMLSentenceEmbedder (BGE-small-en-v1.5).

modules.name: BCILLM
modules.role: ISOLATED MLX adapter: next-word predictor, tokenizer, spectral-state estimator. The ONLY MLX-importing target.

modules.name: BCICloudBridge
modules.role: the network-egress module. ClaudeCLIGenerator (claude -p, Sonnet 5, no API key) and future runtime transports. Must never be a dependency of any BCI* target.

modules.name: NeuralComposeApp
modules.role: SwiftUI app; AppContainer composition root; AppViewModel.

modules.name: WorldModelDemo
modules.role: synthetic-task JEPA+MPC research demo, decoupled from the EEG pipeline.

invariants: MLX isolation: import MLX only in BCILLM — one runtime copy in the linked binary.
No network at runtime EXCEPT the opt-in network-runtimes in BCICloudBridge (Claude today; Ollama in this branch). Each non-local transport is its own opt-in surface and its own banner disclosure.
Stub-by-default: missing model -> mock, missing weights -> stub, bridge stub -> synthetic EEG; the privacy banner reflects the active path.
App talks to subsystems through BCICore protocols only.
Strict concurrency + ExistentialAny enabled on every target.
SpectralState is a heuristic gloss/bias, never a cognitive decode — 4-ch Muse cannot support mental-state claims.
Track A (jaw/blink/rest carousel + dwell-select) is the only supported typing path; Track B (imagined speech) is experimental and pre-registration-gated.

GENERATION RUNTIME INVARIANTS (ADR-009): (1) Prompt profiles belong to the dialectical engine, never to the runtime. (2) The runtime SHALL NOT modify semantic intent. (3) The runtime is transport; the model is configuration. (4) The runtime is capability-advertised, not method-mandatory. (5) Benchmark governance is a separate document, referenced not defined here.
WorldModel/ and Sources/ remain decoupled. The WorldModel branch (worldmodel/overnight-transform-ab) is the historical record of the JEPA+MPC investigation; this branch does not touch it.

public_api_seams.status: NEW (this branch). Transport-level abstraction (HTTP / subprocess / local-process). Composed underneath each GenerationRuntime conformer; not a runtime itself.

public_api_seams.note: selects the user's on-device Personal Voice (bestPersonalVoiceIdentifier / requestPersonalVoiceAuthorization) over Premium/compact; persisted via VoiceProfile (Sources/BCICore/Composition/VoiceProfile.swift -> ~/Documents/NeuralCompose/voice-profile.json). Verified: an ad-hoc-signed app CAN use Personal Voice without the restricted entitlement.

the 'Apple Shortcuts' emitter AppCommand always anticipated: .onOpenURL -> URLCommand.parse -> AppCommand dispatcher, so a Siri Shortcut can trigger speak(text:) in the Personal Voice. Cannot make Siri ITSELF speak in the voice (Apple separation).
